report.title: The first wellbeing prototype is ready for feedback.
paragraphs: The first interactive prototype is working. It guides users through a short reflection: list what is on their mind, place each concern in time, identify the emotion, and decide what can be acted on now.
Concerns that cannot be changed immediately move into a release exercise. The session closes with any concrete actions the user chose to carry forward.

The concept draws from EDUC 215 and independent reading on wellbeing. Feedback from professors and teaching staff will guide revisions to the prompts, emotional pacing, exit paths, and safety boundaries.
report.signature: Sending the next version after the feedback round. — Alina
